# Clouisle

> Open-Source, Self-Hosted AI Workspace for Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Automated Workflows.

Clouisle is an open-source, private-cloud AI workspace designed to keep data in infrastructure you control (zero mandatory third-party data forwarding / "data stays in domain"). It unites multi-agent orchestration, enterprise document retrieval, model management, tool connections, and end-to-end workflows into a single cohesive platform.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Agents**: Autonomous and human-in-the-loop agents that understand business context, plan tasks, call internal tools, and drive work to completion.
- **Enterprise Knowledge Base**: Multimodal document parsing, hybrid retrieval, and precise permission boundaries to ground agent answers in verifiable facts.
- **Workflow Automation**: Visual and code-level DAG orchestration threading models, tools, agents, and human approvals into reproducible business processes.
- **Model Governance & Access Control**: Centralized routing across open-source (Ollama, vLLM) and commercial model APIs with fine-grained team-level RBAC.
- **Data Sovereignty & Security**: 100% self-hosted deployment on Docker or Kubernetes, network-isolated environments, SSO, and verifiable audit logs.
- **Open Source**: Licensed under GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0).
